description: One app a device can be pointed at the stack with, and the code that points it.

code.description:
What the code for this app carries: a link that opens the app at this server where
the app takes one, and the server's address otherwise.

deep_link.description: Whether [`code`](Self::code) is such a link rather than the address alone.

device.description: What somebody would call the device they are holding.

open_source.description: Whether that app is open source. A closed one is never the recommended path.
